notes: {"info":["Two community-driven features, a sidebar-counter hotfix, and a security fix."],"features":["[Hangar](module:hangar): pledges that have been CCU'd to a different ship now show the CURRENT ship as the primary label, with the original pledge name in italics underneath ('from Standalone Ships - STV plus Blue Steel Paint'). An UPGRADED chip on the right makes it obvious. Reported by WhisperDark and @!DakotaVosselman on Discord.","[Spectrum](module:spectrum) DevTracker: new CIG staff posts since your last visit get a NEW chip on the card, like Comm-Link / Patch Notes already do. DevTracker now contributes to the toolbar badge by default — tracked alongside the other RSI feeds. You can opt out of any module from [Settings → Toolbar badge](module:settings/appearance#toolbar-badge), where every checkbox now has a one-line explanation of what it counts.","Hotfix: when the toolbar icon badge bumped for a fresh DevTracker post, the [Spectrum](module:spectrum) sidebar pill stayed empty so you couldn't tell where to click. The Spectrum pill now folds in DevTracker's count (since DevTracker is a sub-tab inside Spectrum). The icon and the sidebar agree again.","Security: bumped a transitive dev dependency (uuid <14) flagged by GitHub Dependabot. No production impact \u2014 the affected package only ran during the build, never shipped in the extension."]}

{"info":["Polish pass — smaller bundle, sturdier modules, friendlier keyboard navigation, and a Settings sidebar in tab mode."],"features":["Popup opens faster — about 14% smaller bundle, and the shared data that used to load on every popup open is now split per-module so it only loads when you actually open the module that needs it.","Smoother scrolling in long lists: [Hangar](module:hangar), [Contacts](module:contacts), [Buy-Back](module:buy-back) and [Community Hub](module:community-hub) only render the rows you can actually see.","Keyboard: Tab now stays inside the Release Notes drawer and the [Roadmap](module:roadmap), [Ships](module:ships), and [Spectrum](module:spectrum) emoji-picker dialogs instead of leaking to the sidebar behind. Closing them returns focus to the button you opened them from.","[Settings → Performance → Cache](module:settings/performance#cache) → Wipe all caches and [Settings → Reset to defaults](module:settings/performance#reset-settings) now ask for confirmation before proceeding.","A malformed block in a [Galactapedia](module:galactapedia) article or a [Spectrum](module:spectrum) thread no longer takes down the whole module — only that block degrades to a small '[render error]' line.","[Hangar](module:hangar) tolerates more RSI markup variations: a single un-parseable pledge row is skipped instead of crashing the rest of your hangar.","In tab mode (full-screen [Settings](module:settings)), a sticky sidebar lists every section in the current tab so you can jump straight to Cache, Toolbar badge, Sidebar modules, etc. without scrolling. Popup mode keeps the original single-column flow — the sidebar only appears when there's room for it.","Slight contrast bump on small text (timestamps, hints, debug info) and the sidebar now announces the active module to screen readers."]}

{"info":["Toolbar badge is now configurable, plus a couple of follow-ups."],"features":["New: [Settings → Appearance → Toolbar badge](module:settings/appearance#toolbar-badge) — pick exactly which modules' unread counts add up to the number on the extension icon. Each module has its own checkbox; defaults match the previous behaviour ([Spectrum](module:spectrum) + [Comm-Link](module:comm-link) + [Patch Notes](module:patch-notes) + [Roadmap](module:roadmap) + [Contacts](module:contacts)). Want to include the extension's own changelog updates? Tick [Release Notes](module:release-notes). Toggling a checkbox repaints the badge instantly.","[Spectrum](module:spectrum) Notifications counter clears instantly when you open the Notifications tab — no more 'click then close then reopen' to make it go away.","All previous release notes (going back to v1.0.0) rewritten to be more readable: shorter, plain English, no internal jargon.","New: release-note entries can now contain clickable links that jump straight to the relevant module, tab, or section. Try the link in the first bullet above ☝️","Default popup height bumped from 530 to 570 px so the larger sidebar (more modules than at v1.3.3) fits without forcing you to resize. Existing custom sizes are kept; click 'Reset' in [Settings → Popup size](module:settings/appearance#popup-size) to adopt the new default."]}

{"info":["Six small fixes from community feedback."],"features":["Switching accounts now shows fresh data right away — no more leftover pledges or orgs from a previous session.","[Buy-Back](module:buy-back) no longer crashes when scrolling.","Genesis Starliner shows the correct loaner (C2 Hercules instead of Mercury Star Runner).","[Comm-Link](module:comm-link) images appear cleanly in one shot — no more half-loaded thumbnails.","[Spectrum](module:spectrum) notifications counter clears as soon as you open the tab or hit 'Mark all read'.","[Comm-Link](module:comm-link) and [Buy-Back](module:buy-back) load the next page earlier and more reliably as you scroll."]}

{"info":["Critical sign-in fix."],"features":["Sign-in now works reliably for everyone. A few accounts had a notification with an unusual shape that prevented the extension from recognising you as signed in.","Robustness pass: a single odd notification can no longer break the rest of your session."]}

{"info":["Easier ways to support the extension."],"features":["After about a week of use, a small banner asks how the extension is going — thumbs up to upvote on the RSI Community Hub or rate on your browser's store, thumbs down to jump to [Support](module:support), 'Later' to snooze, × to dismiss for good.","Permanent 'Help spread the word' section in the [Support](module:support) module — same buttons, available any time without waiting for the prompt.","Privacy: nothing is ever upvoted, rated, or posted on your behalf. The buttons just open the destination page; your click on that page is the real action."]}

{"info":["New [Hangar](module:hangar) module — a per-pledge view of your account, modelled after HangarXPLOR."],"features":["New '[Hangar](module:hangar)' entry in the sidebar (between [Ships](module:ships) and [Buy-Back](module:buy-back)) with three tabs: Pledges (a card per pledge with thumbnail, click to expand), Ships (one row per ship), and Export.","Filter chips you can cycle: click once to keep ONLY this type (e.g. only LTI), click again to HIDE it (e.g. hide Free CCUs), click a third time to clear.","Filters available: LTI, Warbond, Giftable, Meltable, Valuable, Upgraded, Reward, Free CCUs, plus a pledge-type dropdown (Standalone Ships, Game Packages, Combo Packs, Add-Ons, Ship Upgrades, Extras, Paints…).","Big stats banner up top: total spent, plus a filtered subtotal that follows whatever you've narrowed down to.","Bundled ships shown automatically. Owning a Constellation Phoenix? You'll see its Lynx and Archimedes with a 'bundled' badge. Same for Carrack Expedition w/C8X (Pisces).","Export to shiplist.json or shiplist.csv — same format HangarXPLOR uses, so any third-party tool that read HangarXPLOR exports will accept yours unchanged.","No new permissions."]}

{"info":["[Pledge Store](module:pledge-store) and Sync history fixes."],"features":["[Pledge Store](module:pledge-store) → Ships now shows your full catalogue, not just the first 30 entries. RSI's server was secretly capping page size.","[Contacts](module:contacts) → Sync to PTU → Recent syncs: each past run now shows the same 5-card status grid as the live result (Added / Pending / Already friend / No PTU account / Error)."]}
{"info":["Hotfix on the [Pledge Store](module:pledge-store) ships toggle."],"features":["Clicking the on-sale ↔ all-catalogue toggle no longer returns an error from RSI's servers."]}

{"info":["Five small UX fixes."],"features":["[Spectrum](module:spectrum) DevTracker: clicking a post then the back arrow now shows the channel's threads instead of an empty page.","[Roadmap](module:roadmap): every card is now click-to-expand on the whole card, not just the thumbnail. Cards without a thumbnail are reachable too.","[Community Hub](module:community-hub) Home: each strip (Lives, Trending, Gameplay, Tutorial) now appears as soon as its data is ready, instead of waiting for the slowest one.","Forum search no longer crashes when a query returns no results.","[Pledge Store](module:pledge-store) ships count is now a clickable toggle: 'X on sale' / 'X all'. Switch between only-on-sale and the full catalogue."]}

{"info":["[Contacts](module:contacts) friend request actions persist properly."],"features":["Accepting, declining or cancelling a friend request now removes the row instantly. Before, it could briefly come back until you hit Refresh manually."]}

{"info":["Friend requests correctly classified."],"features":["[Contacts](module:contacts) → Pending: incoming and outgoing friend requests are now correctly separated. Before, all of them showed as Incoming, including the ones you had sent yourself."]}

{"info":["[Contacts](module:contacts) → Sync to PTU: more visibility into the auto-retry loop, plus per-error retry."],"features":["'Pending retries' card now shows when the last 12-hour retry ran and what it accomplished (e.g. 'Last tick: 4h ago · 3 retried, 2 succeeded').","Per-error retry button (↻) on entries with an Error status — re-attempts that single contact without rerunning the whole sync.","New 'Recent syncs' panel showing your last 10 sync runs (when, duration, totals)."]}

{"info":["[Contacts](module:contacts) → Sync to PTU now keeps trying on its own."],"features":["Friends without a PTU profile yet land in a pending queue. The extension automatically re-attempts every 12 hours for the next 7 days — they'll move to your PTU friend requests as soon as their profile appears.","New 'Pending retries' card lists every queued contact with its handle, attempt count and time-until-expiry. Per-row × button stops retries for that specific contact; 'Cancel all' wipes the queue.","If a previously not-found contact has since been added / accepted manually, the queue auto-removes them on the next sync."]}

{"info":["[Contacts](module:contacts) → Sync to PTU: live progress instead of a spinner."],"features":["New progress card shows the current phase (reading lists / classifying / adding), an X / Y counter, a progress bar, and the handle currently being processed.","Live entry log: every contact's outcome appears as soon as it's decided, newest at the top.","Cancel button to stop mid-sync. The partial result still shows what got done before stopping."]}

{"info":["[Settings → Performance → Cache panel](module:settings/performance#cache) got richer."],"features":["Each module's cache shows its entries, total size, last-fetch time, and next-expiry — readable at a glance.","Click any row to expand it and see individual cached entries.","Storage quota indicator at the top, so you know how much of your 5 MB limit is in use."]}

{"info":["Cache resilience pass — internal hardening, no UI change."],"features":["Bad cached data is now detected before it can crash a module.","Roadmap and Galactapedia A-Z load instantly from cache even when their cache is past expiry, with a fresh refetch happening in the background."]}
{"info":["Hotfix on [Contacts](module:contacts)."],"features":["[Contacts](module:contacts) module no longer crashes after a background update."]}

{"info":["Two small UX additions."],"features":["Status banner appears at the top of the popup when RSI is in maintenance or down, so it's clear that's their side, not the extension.","[Settings → Performance → Cache](module:settings/performance#cache) → 'Refresh all modules' button clears every cache and refetches everything in one click. Useful when something feels broadly stale (e.g. RSI just came back from an outage)."]}

{"info":["Smarter background polling — no UI change."],"features":["The extension now skips its background poll when RSI is in maintenance or down, instead of wasting requests during outages.","When a single module's data feed is broken, that module backs off automatically without affecting the others."]}

{"info":["Cache and polling tightened — no UI change, performance only."],"features":["Background polls now feed your modules directly, so opening the popup after a poll shows fresh data instantly.","Old expired cache entries are cleaned up automatically on extension startup, instead of accumulating forever."]}

{"info":["More bundled ships correctly marked as owned in [Ships](module:ships)."],"features":["Owning a Constellation Aquila now also marks its bundled Ursa rover as owned.","Owning a Carrack w/C8X or Carrack Expedition w/C8X now also marks the bundled C8X Pisces Expedition as owned."]}

{"info":["Phoenix bundles now show their bundled ships in [Ships](module:ships)."],"features":["Owning a Constellation Phoenix or Phoenix Emerald now correctly marks the bundled Lynx rover and P-72 Archimedes as owned. Before, RSI's hangar consolidates them into the parent and they were silently missing."]}

{"info":["Three [Ships](module:ships) name fixes."],"features":["'A.T.L.S.' (with dots) now matches the ATLS matrix entry. ATLS GEO added too.","'Ursa Rover Fortuna' now matches the Ursa Fortuna matrix entry.","'Dragonfly Star Kitten Edition' now points to the correct Yellowjacket chassis."]}

{"info":["[Spectrum](module:spectrum) DevTracker rebuilt."],"features":["DevTracker now shows the same content as RSI's official /community/devtracker page: Patch Notes, Focus Testing, Feedback, Announcements, Ask The Devs, plus CIG replies inside community threads. Before, only top-level threads in two channels were shown.","Each entry now carries its category label (Patch Notes, Focus Testing, etc.) so you can scan at a glance."]}

{"info":["Firefox / Waterfox / LibreWolf hardening — no UI change."],"features":["Future Firefox-MV2 quirks are now handled at the popup level, so they can't break individual features one at a time.","Crashes that previously only showed up in the browser's DevTools are now visible in Settings → Diagnostics → Recent logs, making bug reports more useful."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on [UI scale](module:settings/appearance#ui-scale) buttons in Firefox."],"features":["[Settings → UI scale](module:settings/appearance#ui-scale) +/- buttons now work on Firefox / Waterfox / LibreWolf.","Ctrl+Scroll to zoom while Settings is open no longer throws an error."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on [Contacts](module:contacts) → Sync to PTU result counts."],"features":["Already-pending friend requests now correctly count as Pending instead of Error.","Per-IP throttles get an automatic 1.5-second retry instead of a hard error.","Per-entry error messages now include what RSI actually said, so it's clear what was rejected.","PTU's outgoing friend requests are now correctly read, so the pre-classification doesn't miss already-pending entries."]}

{"info":["Sign-in self-heals."],"features":["The 'still asks to sign in even though I am' bug is fixed — the extension now double-checks the live cookie before serving a cached signed-out state.","Default popup height bumped from 520 to 530 px (one extra row of breathing space on first install)."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on [Contacts](module:contacts) → Find member search."],"features":["[Contacts](module:contacts) → Find returned 'No citizens found' for every query — works again now. RSI changed their response format and we adapted."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on [Community Hub](module:community-hub)."],"features":["[Community Hub](module:community-hub) tab refused to load on every install — RSI started returning a null value for one field. Adapted."]}

{"info":["[Spectrum](module:spectrum) got a major overhaul — read, vote, react, subscribe, bookmark, and navigate notifications without leaving the popup. Plus a critical fix that resurrected the extension on Firefox / Waterfox / LibreWolf."],"features":["Forums: full browse tree (community → channel → thread → replies). Works for Star Citizen and every org you're part of. Hot / New / Top / Active sort buttons all work now.","Read posts with rich text, inline community emojis, media previews on cards, and the official CIG gold tint on staff posts. Member org and role badges appear next to author names.","Vote: ▲ button on every thread and reply.","React: full emoji picker on threads, replies, and DM messages — including custom community emojis and ~250 standard shortcodes (face_palm, fire, country flags via :fr: / :us:).","Subscribe: bell button to watch a channel or a specific thread.","Bookmarks: star a thread, or bookmark an entire forum channel from its header. Click any item in the Bookmarks tab to drill into it.","Notifications: clicking a notif now marks it read AND jumps you straight to the thread or lobby — inside the popup, no new browser tab.","DMs: read-only chat history with auto-poll, member badges, and the same react / picker UX as forums.","In-popup navigation: clicking a card in DevTracker / Trending / Bookmarks / Notifications opens it inside the popup. Ctrl/Cmd/Shift/middle-click still opens externally.","Forum search box across thread titles in the current channel.","[Community Hub](module:community-hub): new Home tab with Live, Trending, Gameplay, and Tutorial strips.","Firefox / Waterfox / LibreWolf: every [Spectrum](module:spectrum) and module-fetch action that was silently hanging now works.","Org badges (logos) in [Spectrum](module:spectrum) now render properly instead of showing as broken images.","Bookmark add / remove now works regardless of whether you have an RSI tab open elsewhere."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on [Community Hub](module:community-hub) post links."],"features":["Clicking a post in Discover / Gameplay / Tutorial no longer leads to a 404. RSI changed the URL format on their side."]}

{"info":["Three small fixes from the first week of reports."],"features":["Firefox / Waterfox: toolbar-badge unread counts ([Comm-Link](module:comm-link), [Patch Notes](module:patch-notes), Status alerts) now update again. The popup itself was unaffected.","[Patch Notes](module:patch-notes): removed the LIVE / PTU / EPTU / TECH-PREVIEW filter — CIG only publishes LIVE patches these days, so the other tabs were always empty. Per-card coloured badges still tell you what kind of build each note covers.","[Release Notes](module:release-notes) module: dates next to each version are now correct."]}

{"info":["Popup resizable, [Settings](module:settings) reorganised, new [Support](module:support) module, plus a quiet but important [Ships](module:ships) fix."],"features":["[Settings → Popup size](module:settings/appearance#popup-size): two sliders to set the popup window dimensions.","[Settings → UI scale](module:settings/appearance#ui-scale): ±/Reset controls (works in tab mode).","Tab mode: sidebar gets more breathing room — wider rail, larger icons, more spacing.","[Settings](module:settings) reorganised into three top-level tabs (Appearance, Performance, Diagnostics).","New [Support](module:support) module: GitHub repo, pre-filled bug-report URL, Discord invite, FAQ, About card.","[Ships](module:ships): legacy referral and subscriber pledges (e.g. 'Surf and Turf' with a PTV, 'Gladius and Gold' with an F7A Hornet Mk II) now show up in your Owned list. Your Owned count finally matches what's in the RSI hangar end-to-end.","[Roadmap](module:roadmap): more zombie release entries filtered out."]}

{"info":["Three more [Ships](module:ships)-detection fixes."],"features":["Older referral and subscriber bundles (e.g. 'Surf and Turf' with a PTV, 'Gladius and Gold' with an F7A Hornet Mk II) now show up in your Owned ships.","'Genesis Starliner' now correctly matches the matrix's 'Genesis' entry.","Trailing whitespace on RSI ship names (the C8X Pisces Expedition was affected) no longer breaks matching."]}

{"info":["Several fixes from the first round of community feedback."],"features":["[Ships](module:ships): ships included in game-package pledges are now detected. Before, packages whose first item was an Insurance or Digital Download row were silently hiding every ship inside.","[Ships](module:ships): 'Copy hangar dump' button copies a snapshot of your hangar to the clipboard — makes bug reports about ship detection trivial.","[Ships](module:ships): paints, components, multi-tools, tractor beams, subscriber flair, etc. no longer appear as 'unknown ships'.","[Ships](module:ships): ground vehicles tagged as 'Vehicle' (some older PTV / Cyclone pledges) are now accepted alongside those tagged 'Ship'.","[Roadmap](module:roadmap): live patches (4.4 / 4.5 / 4.6 / 4.7+) now correctly appear under 'Released' instead of 'Upcoming'.","[Roadmap](module:roadmap): zombie entries with zero cards no longer clutter the Upcoming list."]}

{"info":["Two features brought back from the v2 extension by popular demand, plus bug fixes from v1.0.2 (which only reached Firefox)."],"features":["[Organizations](module:organizations): each org member row now has a 'send contact request' button — no more copy-pasting handles into the search box.","[Contacts](module:contacts) → Sync to PTU: one-click workflow that mirrors your LIVE friend list onto your PTU account. PTU's social graph is separate from LIVE and never auto-syncs, so without this you'd start every test wave with an empty contact list.","[Spectrum](module:spectrum): communities with an unusual channel colour no longer break every signed-in module.","Older Firefox-based browsers (Waterfox, older ESRs) no longer flood the console with errors."]}

{"info":["Firefox-only maintenance release. Chrome and Edge users skip 1.0.2 and get the same fixes in 1.1.0."],"features":["[Spectrum](module:spectrum): communities with an unusual channel colour no longer break every signed-in module.","Older Firefox-based browsers no longer flood the console with errors."]}

{"info":["First stable release after years of 0.x pre-release. Complete rebuild with a new stack and Firefox support."],"features":["Fresh redesign — Firefox now supported alongside Chrome and Edge.","[Pledge Store](module:pledge-store): browse ships, paints, gear, game packages, packs, merch, add-ons, event tickets, gift cards and UEC — with live prices.","Shopping cart: add, remove and clear items directly from the extension. One-click jump to checkout on RSI.","CCU Upgrade tool: find cross-chassis upgrade routes from your owned ships with real-time pricing.","Ship detail pages built-in — specs, components, variants, editions and prices without leaving the extension.","[Galactapedia](module:galactapedia) reader — full articles, categories with thumbnails, featured picks, random-article button.","[Settings](module:settings) module: clear cache, customize the sidebar, toggle prefetch, export a debug bundle for bug reports.","Full-screen tab mode — open the extension in a browser tab with a responsive layout.","Favorites: star ships and [Galactapedia](module:galactapedia) articles for quicker access.","RSI Status pill in the header showing server health at a glance.","[Comm-Link](module:comm-link) full search: channel, series, type filters and sort options like on the official site.","[Progress Tracker](module:progress-tracker): roadmap cards grouped by category.","[Community Hub](module:community-hub): Live, Events, Discover, Gameplay and Tutorial feeds.","[Organizations](module:organizations): dedicated Membership, Invitations and Applications tabs.","Referral Program visible in the header and [Dashboard](module:dashboard), with recruits and prospects.","Most modules render instantly on repeat opens.","A crashing module no longer locks the whole popup — reload just that one module.","[Roadmap](module:roadmap) with change highlights: cards marked as new, moved or removed since your last visit.","Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl/Cmd+K for search, Alt+1..9 to jump between modules, Esc to dismiss."]}
